items.name: elastic bandage wrap, 3 in
items.note: Medical supplies such as bandages are includible.

items.name: ankle support sleeve, medium
items.note: Supports aren't named in the sources; they are medical equipment when used to treat an injury or condition, not when worn for general athletic use.

items.name: ovulation test strips, 20 count
items.note: Not named in the sources; fertility testing is includible when used to overcome an inability to have children, but routine family planning use isn't clearly covered.

items.name: dextromethorphan cough syrup, 4 oz
items.note: Cold, flu and cough medicines are OTC medicines, eligible without a prescription after 2019.

items.name: amplified telephone, 40 dB
items.note: Special telephone equipment that lets a person who is deaf, hard of hearing or speech disabled communicate is includible; an amplified phone sold to anyone needs documentation of that use.

items.name: CBD gummies 25 mg, 30 count
items.note: CBD products are herbal/'natural' supplements taken for general well-being, not medical care.

items.name: cetirizine 10 mg, 45 count
items.note: Allergy medicines are OTC medicines, eligible without a prescription after 2019.

items.name: cool mist humidifier
items.note: A household item is includible only if used primarily to alleviate an illness; plans require a letter of medical necessity to show that.

items.name: bathtub transfer rail
items.note: Grab bars, railings and ramps are includible in full when installed to accommodate a disabled condition; the receipt can't show that, so plans require medical documentation.
